title: Care Plan Desk Cross-Notice: Release on a New Piece Costing Twice the Credit
content:
Where the new piece costs at least twice the credit still available on a registration under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes, a share of the amount spent above the least the customer must spend is added to the credit put toward the sale, and the share depends on whether cover for a piece stands quoted on the customer's file under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans.

## The notice

Where the price of the new piece reaches twice the credit still available and cover for a piece stands quoted on the customer's file, two fifths (40 percent) of the amount spent above the least the customer must spend is added. Where the price of the new piece reaches twice the credit still available and no cover stands quoted, a fifth (20 percent) of it is added. Where the price of the new piece does not reach twice the credit still available, nothing is added.

Cover stands quoted where a protection plan on the customer's file is at the quoted standing.

## Cases on hypothetical figures

Take a credit still available of 4000 USD, so that twice it is 8000 USD, and an amount spent above the least the customer must spend of 1500 USD.

| Price of the new piece | Cover quoted on the file | Share added | Amount added (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9000 USD | yes | 40 percent | 600.00 |
| 9000 USD | no | 20 percent | 300.00 |
| 8000 USD | yes | 40 percent | 600.00 |
| 7999 USD | yes | none | 0.00 |
| 7999 USD | no | none | 0.00 |

A price of exactly twice the credit still available reaches the threshold; a price a penny below it does not.
